playstyle.identity: Zeri is a mobile ADC whose autos are skillshots. Her ultimate gives her massive speed and chain lightning, making her a nightmare to catch in teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: charged autos steal shield. Q is her main auto-replacement skillshot. W pierces terrain. E dashes over walls. R gives speed and chain lightning on hit, stacking from hits. E over walls, Q as main damage, R to kite and stack in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zeri spikes at level 6 with her speed and at 3 items. Trinity Force or crit scale her. She's strong in extended teamfights.

passive.name: Living Battery
passive.summary: Auto attacks are skillshots; steal shields from enemies.
passive.details: Zeri's basic attacks deal magic damage and steal enemy shields. She gains shield when damaging shields.

abilities.name: Burst Fire
abilities.summary: Fire a burst of shots in a line (acts as her auto attack).
abilities.details: Zeri fires a burst of rounds that deal physical damage. This is treated as her basic attack and applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Ultrashock Laser
abilities.summary: Fire a laser that deals more damage through terrain.
abilities.details: Zeri fires an electric pulse. If it hits terrain, it becomes a long-range laser that slows and deals more damage.

abilities.name: Spark Surge
abilities.summary: Dash, gaining speed; can dash through terrain.
abilities.details: Zeri dashes a short distance, gaining attack speed. If she dashes into terrain, she vaults over it.

abilities.name: Lightning Crash
abilities.summary: Gain massive speed; attacks chain lightning. Stacks on hit.
abilities.details: Zeri discharges electricity, damaging nearby enemies and gaining massive movement speed and chain lightning on her attacks. Each hit extends the duration and adds stacks.
